philosophy: Illustrative Rs 1,00,000 allocation drawn purely from this project's Tier-A bucket (conviction_score >= 60, thesis_fit = 10x-in-2-3-years, no red flag). Tier A more than doubled this cycle (6 -> 12 names) as a broad, mechanical quality-data refresh (more deepdive coverage feeding quality_lift) lifted scores across most of the prior Tier-B batch simultaneously -- HBL Engineering, Vivid Electromech, Raymond Realty, Entero Healthcare, P.E. Analytics, Matrimony.com and Dynamic Cables all crossed 60 this run. Wockhardt Ltd's score fell from 61.3 to 55.9 on trusted-signal recency decay and exits the Tier-A bucket (and this portfolio) this cycle -- the underlying Zaynich/margin-turnaround thesis is unchanged, it simply no longer clears the mechanical bar. Two Tier-A names (Vivid Electromech, P.E. Analytics) have no resolvable Yahoo Finance symbol (illiquid SME/micro-cap listings) and are excluded from this tradable allocation pending a manual price check, not because of any thesis concern. Of the remaining ten, sizing follows conviction_score and thesis-return-magnitude, tilted by the expectation-gap read: Aeroflex and HBL are held at the smallest positions despite high/mid conviction because their expectation-gap scores flag the catalyst as already priced in (Aeroflex 0, 'over-optimistic') or lacking a near-term catalyst (HBL, 'no-catalyst', gap 24). The book now spans ten largely independent sectors -- specialty pharma, machine tools, diagnostics, AI-datacentre thermal, industrial packaging, rail signalling/Kavach, real-estate redevelopment, healthcare distribution, internet/matchmaking platform and power cables -- a meaningfully more diversified book than the prior six-name version. Prices were live-pulled from Yahoo Finance at compile time (2026-09-11); reverify before acting. A ~12% cash buffer is held back.
allocation_note: ~88% deployed (Rs 88,241.60), ~12% (Rs 11,758.40) held as cash buffer. Sizing rule: conviction_score sets the base weight, then an expectation-gap tilt adjusts it -- Venus (score 91, gap 70 favourable) and Thyrocare (score 75, gap 55 favourable) get the top two slots; Aeroflex (score 85, the batch's second-highest) and HBL Engineering (score 66) are held at the smallest positions in the book because their expectation-gap scores flag the near-term catalyst as already priced in (Aeroflex: 0, 'over-optimistic') or absent (HBL: 24, 'no-catalyst') despite otherwise clearing Tier A comfortably. Vivid Electromech (score 62) and P.E. Analytics (score 61) are Tier-A by score but excluded from this tradable allocation -- no resolvable Yahoo symbol (SME/micro-cap, likely illiquid) -- reprice manually before considering either. All ten listed prices were live-pulled from Yahoo Finance (VENUSREM.NS, THYROCARE.NS, TIMETECHNO.NS, MACPOWER.NS, DYCL.NS, MATRIMONY.NS, ENTERO.NS, RAYMONDREL.NS, HBLENGINE.NS, AEROFLEX.NS) at compile time 2026-09-11 -- reverify before acting, markets move.

stocks.name: Venus Remedies
stocks.tagline: Turned-around, debt-free injectables/oncology exporter whose FY26 filings confirm the inflection is cash-backed
stocks.thesis: Venus generates ~Rs 811 Cr revenue at 4x the EBITDA of peer Orchid Pharma, yet trades at roughly 1/5th Orchid's market cap and 2-3x cheaper than peers Sakar, Beta Drugs and Sai Parenteral -- a peer-valuation-gap re-rating thesis, not a pure growth story. FY26 confirmed the profit is real: CFO matched or exceeded EBITDA for a second straight year while receivables fell, revenue +17.9%, PAT +127%. Balance sheet is genuinely debt-free (~Rs 12 Cr borrowings, >Rs 250 Cr cash, zero pledge), first dividend in 13 years. A trusted investor (phreakv6, core-tier) disclosed a position on this exact thesis.
stocks.sizing_rationale: Highest conviction_score in the whole batch (91.37) combined with the most favourable expectation-gap read (70, no 'priced-in' flag) -- the largest position by a clear margin.
stocks.watch_for: ~Rs 23 Cr of FY26 operating profit was one-offs (Cipla milestone + PLI incentive) -- normalised OPM is ~17%, not the 20.8% headline. Management previously set and missed a Rs 1,000 Cr FY25 revenue target, so any new guidance carries a credibility discount. Still no concalls or investor presentations despite the size reached.

stocks.name: Thyrocare Technologies
stocks.tagline: Debt-free, asset-light diagnostics chain with accelerating PAT growth and a compressing multiple
stocks.thesis: FY26 PAT +81% YoY, Q1 FY27 PAT +34% YoY, on an almost debt-free, asset-light diagnostics-chain model. The trailing multiple has compressed purely because profit growth has outrun the price. A radiology-segment divestment is concretely in-process and would sharpen the core-business focus plus add a one-time cash catalyst.
stocks.sizing_rationale: conviction_score 75.0 with a favourable expectation-gap read (55) -- sized second after Venus.
stocks.watch_for: Promoter holding has fallen sharply via staged stake sales to repay parent debt -- track that this stabilises rather than continuing to decline. The radiology divestment closing (or stalling) is the near-term event to watch.

stocks.name: Time Technoplast
stocks.tagline: Industrial-packaging compounder finishing a multi-year deleveraging, cheap and with a favourable expectation-gap read
stocks.thesis: Multiple consecutive quarters of ~20-25% PAT growth, composite (value-added) mix rising, ROCE guided higher, net debt falling toward net-debt-free -- the falling interest drag is a structural, steel-price-independent earnings tailwind on top of volume growth. Cheapest-multiple name in the book with the second-best expectation-gap read (52, 'underestimated').
stocks.sizing_rationale: conviction_score 70.37, expectation-gap 51.59 (favourable, 'underestimated') -- sized just behind the top two on the strength of the gap read despite a mid-tier conviction score.
stocks.watch_for: The VAP-mix shift and the net-debt-free milestone are the thesis -- a stall in either breaks it. Guidance credibility is historically mixed.

stocks.name: Macpower CNC Machines
stocks.tagline: CNC machine-tool inflection confirmed across four straight quarters, funded by a capacity-doubling greenfield plant
stocks.thesis: Multiple consecutive quarters of accelerating revenue/EBITDA growth, driven by a capacity-doubling greenfield plant and a shift toward the premium NEXA product line. Domestic machine-tool import-substitution tailwind underpins the multi-year growth case.
stocks.sizing_rationale: conviction_score 80.75, the third-highest in the batch, but expectation-gap only 30.47 (moderate, growth partially priced) -- held below Venus/Thyrocare/Time Technoplast on that basis.
stocks.watch_for: Rich trailing multiple already prices in a good chunk of the growth; cash conversion has run behind reported PAT during the capacity ramp -- watch for this normalising as the greenfield plant scales.

stocks.name: Dynamic Cables
stocks.tagline: Power-cable maker on the T&D + solar capex super-cycle, best expectation-gap read among the new Tier-A entrants
stocks.thesis: ~30% growth confirmed across multiple concalls, ROCE ~27%, long-term debt repaid, UL 854 + PGCIL approvals opening export/utility demand. Was legacy Tier A in the older screen; re-enters this cycle on the mechanical score refresh.
stocks.sizing_rationale: conviction_score 60.18 (just crossed the Tier-A threshold this cycle) but the best expectation-gap score of the seven new entrants (64.57) -- sized ahead of the other newcomers on that basis.
stocks.watch_for: A ~Rs 344 Cr Indokrates promoter-related guarantee and capex-timing slippage are the live risks. Confirm the score holds above 60 for a second cycle before treating this as a settled Tier-A position.

stocks.name: Matrimony.com Ltd
stocks.tagline: Hated, cheap category leader with margins inflecting and a favourable expectation-gap read
stocks.thesis: Category leader earning the large majority of industry profits at a modest EV ex-cash, with easing competition, a buying promoter and operating leverage inflecting (PAT growth well ahead of revenue).
stocks.sizing_rationale: conviction_score 60.25 (just crossed the Tier-A threshold) with a favourable expectation-gap score (57.57) -- sized level with Dynamic Cables.
stocks.watch_for: The re-rate case is real but needs margins to hold for 2-3 more quarters to be considered confirmed rather than a one-off.

stocks.name: Entero Healthcare Solutions Ltd
stocks.tagline: Five consecutive quarters of confirmed EBITDA margin expansion in pharma distribution
stocks.thesis: EBITDA margin expansion confirmed across five straight quarters (2.8% -> 4.5%), market cap below TTM sales -- the strongest methodology-confirmed margin-inflection case in the batch.
stocks.sizing_rationale: conviction_score 61.42 (just crossed Tier A) with a moderate expectation-gap read (32.72) -- mid-sized position among the newcomers.
stocks.watch_for: Distribution-business margins are thin and competitive by nature -- confirm the margin expansion continues rather than mean-reverting as competitors respond.

stocks.name: Raymond Realty Ltd
stocks.tagline: Real embedded-value gap in Thane redevelopment, tempered by leverage
stocks.thesis: #1 Thane West market share confirmed by multiple trusted elevated users; strong revenue/EBITDA growth YoY; promoter open-market buying; large JDA signed; institutional stake entry; large estimated project surplus per the Aug-2026 investor presentation.
stocks.sizing_rationale: conviction_score 61.79 (just crossed Tier A) with a moderate expectation-gap read (30.04) -- sized level with Entero Healthcare, held back of the top-conviction names by real-estate-accounting-driven trailing-ROCE distortion and leverage (D/E ~9.81).
stocks.watch_for: Trailing ROCE is distorted by RE accounting, not a genuine profitability signal yet -- watch cash-flow realisation as the Thane JDA and other projects convert bookings to cash.

stocks.name: HBL Engineering
stocks.tagline: Kavach order-book story with excellent trailing returns, but no near-term catalyst per the expectation-gap read
stocks.thesis: Kavach (train-collision-avoidance) order-book story with excellent trailing returns; multiple elevated-tier trusted users hold it as a top position. Q1 FY27 miss and Tonbo JV uncertainty are live headwinds, independently re-verified as not floor-derived.
stocks.sizing_rationale: conviction_score 65.75, the third-highest of the seven new entrants, but the expectation-gap score (24.19) carries an explicit 'no-catalyst' flag -- held to the smallest position in the book alongside Aeroflex on that basis.
stocks.watch_for: The 'no-catalyst' flag means the re-rating case needs a fresh, dated trigger (a confirmed large order, Tonbo JV resolution) to re-rate further from here -- absent that, this is a name to hold, not add to.

stocks.name: Aeroflex Industries Ltd
stocks.tagline: AI data-centre liquid-cooling pivot confirmed in the numbers, but expectation-gap scoring flags it fully priced in
stocks.thesis: Flexible-hose maker whose pivot into liquid-cooling skids/flow-control for AI data centres (supplying Vertiv) is showing up in reported numbers. A core-trusted investor holds this as a primary position on the same thesis.
stocks.sizing_rationale: conviction_score 84.62, the second-highest in the batch, but expectation-gap score is 0 with an explicit 'over-optimistic' flag -- deliberately capped at the smallest position in the book despite the high conviction score, unchanged reasoning from prior cycles.
stocks.watch_for: Any deceleration in the skids/liquid-cooling revenue mix, or evidence the Vertiv relationship is at risk rather than expanding, removes the only justification for the stretched multiple. The single most valuation-fragile name in the book.

risk_management: 2026-09-11 cycle: Tier A grew from 6 to 12 names on a broad mechanical score refresh (more deepdive/quality-score coverage lifting quality_lift across the board), not from fresh individual catalysts on each name -- treat the seven newcomers (HBL, Vivid Electromech, Raymond Realty, Entero Healthcare, P.E. Analytics, Matrimony.com, Dynamic Cables) as provisional until their scores hold above 60 for a second cycle.

Wockhardt Ltd exited the portfolio this cycle: conviction_score fell from 61.3 to 55.9 (below the Tier-A floor) purely on trusted-signal recency decay, not new negative news. The underlying Zaynich/margin-turnaround thesis is intact -- re-add if the score recrosses 60.

Vivid Electromech and P.E. Analytics are Tier-A by score (62.09 and 61.05) but excluded from this tradable allocation -- no resolvable Yahoo Finance symbol, likely illiquid SME/micro-cap listings. Resolve pricing manually before considering either for inclusion.

Ten sectors represented (specialty pharma, diagnostics, industrial packaging, machine tools, power cables, internet platform, healthcare distribution, real estate, rail signalling, AI-datacentre thermal) -- materially more diversified than the prior six-name book, though Venus (specialty pharma) and Entero (healthcare distribution) both carry some healthcare-sector correlation.

Aeroflex and HBL Engineering are held at the smallest positions in the book (6% each) specifically because their expectation-gap scores flag the near-term catalyst as priced-in or absent -- do not add to either without a fresh expectation-gap improvement.
All ten prices were live-pulled from Yahoo Finance at compile time (2026-09-11) -- reverify before acting, especially for the newly-added names which have not been priced in a prior cycle.

Cash buffer (~12%) held given how much of Venus, Aeroflex, Macpower and Thyrocare has already re-rated; redeploy only into a fresh Tier-A entry that holds for a second cycle, or an existing position pulling back to a materially cheaper multiple.
